integrity: The all-parameter proof uses explicit Fano-plane dependency and matching weight ratios. A finite verifier independently checks selected parameters, not the infinite range. No third-party or independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact value pertains solely to the displayed dimension-three binary family and invertible linear code maps; it does not optimize over all nonisometric codes of a given length or all possible mappings. title: Exact distortion of an isospectral binary code family in dimension three
